title: 第86章 轧钢车间

第86章 轧钢车间-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

六月三十号，一个月的时间终于结束了。王建新本来已经在盘算着回学校的事，谁也没想到，最后一天出了大事。

那天上午，轧钢车间发生了一起严重的工伤事故。王建新正在诊室里给一个腰疼的工人扎针，银针刚刺入穴位，门就被人从外面猛地撞开了。陈国庆跌跌撞撞地冲进来，脸色煞白，额头上全是汗，工作服上沾着灰，手都在抖。

“王队长！”他的声音变了，不是平时那种沉稳，而是一种近乎慌张的焦虑，“轧钢车间出事了！钢坯跑偏，砸了三个工人，伤得很重！”

王建新拔了针，连跟病人解释的时间都没有，拎起医疗包就往外跑。刘晓东、李建国、郭强、张树清、孙长河、周小梅、陈秀英七个人听见动静，二话不说，带好所有东西——夹板、绷带、止血带、急救药品、消毒器械——跟在后面就跑。八个人一路狂奔，医疗包在胯骨上颠得啪啪响，白大褂的下摆被风吹得翻起来。

医务室到轧钢车间，平时走路要十五分钟。他们跑了不到五分钟。王建新跑在最前面，刘晓东跑得气喘吁吁，脸涨得通红，但咬着牙没掉队。周小梅和陈秀英也跑得上气不接下气，但手里的药箱端得稳稳的。

轧钢车间的门口围了一大群人，工人、干部、保卫科的，里三层外三层。有人在大声喊“让开让开”，有人在哭，乱成一锅粥。工人们看见王建新他们来了，自动让开一条路，有人喊“大夫来了大夫来了”，声音里带着希望。

王建新冲进去，眼前的场景让他心头一沉。

三个人躺在地上，身下全是血，铁锈味混着血腥味，呛得人嗓子发紧。周围的工人们脸上全是惊恐，有人蹲在旁边不敢动，有人握着伤员的手一直说“坚持住坚持住”。

第一个人伤得最重，左前臂被钢坯砸中，骨头粉碎性骨折，断端刺破皮肤，白生生的骨茬子露在外面，上面还挂着血丝和碎肉。整条胳膊从肘关节以下都是歪的，角度不对，血从伤口往外涌，地上已经积了一摊暗红色的血。他的脸色惨白，嘴唇发灰，意识已经开始模糊了，眼睛半睁半闭，嘴里含混不清地说着什么。

第二个人右小腿被飞溅的钢屑烫伤，烫伤面积大约百分之十三，二度到三度。皮肤焦黑发硬，有的地方裂开了，露出下面红白相间的肌肉组织，边缘有水泡，有的水泡已经破了，渗出淡黄色的液体。他疼得直叫，声音都哑了，满头大汗，身上的工装被汗浸透了。

第三个人被砸中头部，意识模糊，头皮从额顶掀开到枕部，翻开了一大片，露出一块白花花的颅骨，鲜血顺着脸往下淌，糊满了整张脸，看不清五官，只能看见两个眼睛珠子在动。他的身体在抽搐，一下一下的，不自主地抖。

王建新蹲下来，用神识扫了一遍三个人的伤情，脑子里快速过了一遍。前后不到十秒，他站起来，开始下令。

“郭强、张树清，你们处理小腿烫伤的伤员！”他的声音不大，但每个字都清清楚楚，像刀切的一样利落。“生理盐水冲洗创面，动作要轻，冲干净了用无菌纱布覆盖，不要涂任何药膏，等我们回头再处理。注意观察呼吸，烫伤面积大，小心休克。”

郭强和张树清应了一声，蹲到第二个伤员身边，打开药箱，拿出生理盐水瓶子和无菌纱布，开始冲洗。伤员疼得直哆嗦，郭强一边冲一边说“忍一下忍一下”，手上的动作尽量放轻。

On June 30th, a month finally came to an end.Wang Jianxin was already thinking about going back to school, but no one expected that something big would happen on the last day.

That morning, a serious work accident occurred in the steel rolling workshop.Wang Jianxin was in the clinic giving acupuncture to a worker who had back pain. As soon as the silver needle penetrated the acupuncture point, the door was slammed open from the outside.Chen Guoqing stumbled in. His face was pale, his forehead was covered with sweat, his work clothes were stained with dust, and his hands were shaking.

"Captain Wang!" His voice changed. It was not as calm as usual, but almost panicked. "There was an accident in the steel rolling workshop! The billet went astray and hit three workers. They were seriously injured!"

Wang Jianxin pulled out the needle and didn't even have time to explain to the patient. He picked up the medical bag and ran out.When Liu Xiaodong, Li Jianguo, Guo Qiang, Zhang Shuqing, Sun Changhe, Zhou Xiaomei and Chen Xiuying heard the noise, without saying a word, they took everything with them - splints, bandages, tourniquets, first aid medicines, and disinfection equipment - and ran after them.The eight people ran all the way, their medical bags clattering on their hips, and the hems of their white coats were blown up by the wind.

It usually takes fifteen minutes to walk from the medical office to the steel rolling workshop.They ran for less than five minutes.Wang Jianxin ran at the front. Liu Xiaodong was out of breath and flushed, but he gritted his teeth and did not fall behind.Zhou Xiaomei and Chen Xiuying were also out of breath running, but the medicine boxes in their hands were still stable.

A large group of people gathered at the door of the steel rolling workshop, workers, cadres, and people from the security department, three floors inside and three outside.Some people were shouting "get out of the way, get out of the way", others were crying, and it was a mess.When the workers saw Wang Jianxin and others coming, they moved out of the way. Someone shouted, "The doctor is here, the doctor is here," with hope in his voice.

Wang Jianxin rushed in, and the scene in front of him made his heart sink.

Three people were lying on the ground, covered in blood. The smell of rust mixed with the smell of blood made their throats tighten.The faces of the surrounding workers were full of fear. Some were squatting nearby and did not dare to move. Some were holding the injured man's hand and kept saying "Hold on, hold on."

The first man was the most seriously injured. His left forearm was hit by the steel billet. His bones were shattered and the broken end pierced his skin. The white bone stubble was exposed, and there were still blood streaks and pieces of meat hanging on it.The entire arm was crooked from the elbow joint down, the angle was wrong, blood was pouring out from the wound, and there was a pool of dark red blood on the ground.His face was pale, his lips were gray, his consciousness had begun to blur, his eyes were half-open and half-closed, and he was saying something incomprehensible.

The second person's right calf was burned by flying steel chips. The burn area was about 13%, second to third degree.The skin was burnt black and hard, cracked in some places, revealing the red and white muscle tissue underneath. There were blisters on the edges, and some of the blisters had burst, exuding light yellow liquid.He screamed in pain, his voice was hoarse, he was sweating profusely, and his overalls were soaked with sweat.

The third man was hit on the head and became unconscious. His scalp was opened from the forehead to the occipital area, and a large piece of his skull was revealed. Blood was flowing down his face, covering his entire face. He couldn't see his facial features clearly. Only two eyeballs could be seen moving.His body was twitching, shaking involuntarily.

Wang Jianxin squatted down and scanned the injuries of the three people with his spiritual consciousness, going through them quickly in his mind.In less than ten seconds, he stood up and began to give orders.

"Guo Qiang, Zhang Shuqing, take care of the injured with calf burns!" His voice was not loud, but every word was clear and as sharp as a knife."Rinse the wound with normal saline. Be gentle. Cover it with sterile gauze after rinsing. Do not apply any ointment. We will deal with it later. Pay attention to your breathing. If the burn area is large, be careful of shock."

Guo Qiang and Zhang Shuqing responded, squatted next to the second wounded person, opened the medicine box, took out the saline bottle and sterile gauze, and began to rinse.The wounded man was shivering in pain. Guo Qiang rushed and said, "Bear it, bear it." He tried to be as gentle as possible with his hands.
